The handwriting was careful and small: 'If you find this, tell my sister I kept the promise.' There was a name, a town he had never heard of, and a date forty years old. Elias read it three times. Then he took out his own paper and began writing a letter, unsure who would answer, certain he had to try.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没醒。路灯把空荡的街道照成一片昏黄，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎压过积水，声音很快就散了。便利店的灯一直亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处的高楼只剩几扇窗还亮，不知道是谁在加班，还是谁睡不着。环卫工人推着车慢慢走，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。风有点凉，带着早点铺刚生起的煤烟味。再过一会儿，天边会泛白，第一班公交车会开出站，这座城市又要开始忙碌的一天。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something is solved by doing a smaller version of the same thing.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding a smaller box inside, then opening that one too, again and again.\n- You stop when you reach the tiniest box that has no box inside, and that stopping point is called the base case."}
